CodBi_BayVIS_Behoerde.description: Apply to an XTextField or XSpan whose content should be filled with data of a BayVIS authority building specified in the global variable BayVIS_Behoerde.

CodBi_BayVIS_BehoerdeUndAnsprechpartner.description: Apply to an XTextField or XSpan whose content should be filled with data of a BayVIS authority AND its contact person specified in BayVIS_Behoerde and BayVIS_Hauptansprechpartner.

CodBi_BayVIS_Ansprechpartner.description: Apply to an XTextField or XSpan whose content should be filled with contact person data from BayVIS specified in BayVIS_WeitereAnsprechpartner.

CodBi_BayVIS_Auswahl_Behoerden.description: Apply to an XSelect that should list all available BayVIS authorities for selection.
